title: Construction of infinite time bubble tower solutions to critical wave maps equation
summary: We construct infinite time bubble tower solutions to the critical wave maps equation taking values in the two-sphere. More precisely, for any integers $k\geq3$ and $J\geq1$, we construct a solution that is global in one time direction, has $k$-corotational symmetry, and asymptotically decomposes into $J$-many concentric bubbles of alternating signs with asymptotically vanishing radiation. The scales of each bubble are of order $t^{-α_{j}}$ with $α_{j}=(\frac{k}{k-2})^{j-1}-1$. This shows the existence of multi-bubble solutions with an arbitrary number of bubbles in soliton resolution,…
